question: List down the name of cards with original types of Creature - Elf and the date of rulings for these cards.
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching rulings record.
gold: SELECT T1.id, T2.date FROM cards AS T1 LEFT JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.originalType = 'Creature - Elf'
gold0: SELECT T1.id, T2.date FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.originalType = 'Creature - Elf'

b.request: List the name of every card whose originalType is "Creature - Elf" along with the date of each of its rulings, and include cards that have no rulings (with an empty ruling date)
b.sql: SELECT c.name, r.date FROM cards c LEFT JOIN rulings r ON r.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.originalType = 'Creature - Elf'

c.sql: SELECT c.name, r.date FROM cards c LEFT JOIN rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid WHERE c.originalType = 'Creature - Elf'
